assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production artwork for a carefully crafted layered paper diorama of a fictional Wuhan Hankou neighborhood breakfast shop circa late 1980s. Art direction: sophisticated Chinese illustrated storybook, hand-cut paper collage with dry gouache pigment, expressive subtle woodcut linework, visible warm cotton-paper grain. Restrained palette oxblood red, indigo charcoal, muted jade, tobacco wood, ivory; beautiful bold designed shapes, NOT photorealism, NOT anime, NOT generic flat vector clipart. Warm morning light from upper left, subdued painted shadows, no hard baked outer cast shadow. No text, no watermark. Asset: landscape rectangular interior backdrop print, aspect about 3:2. STRICT frontal orthographic view, flat architectural elevation. A dark intimate tiny breakfast shop back wall: aged pale plaster over dark blue-gray brick, irregular exposed patches, old timber shelves at right holding small ivory-and-cobalt porcelain bowls, tin tea canisters, a thermos, stack of bamboo steamers, hanging cotton towel and used ladles; small dim warm bare bulb at top middle. At left an old rectangular wooden lattice window with muted blue morning glass. Central lower space dark uncluttered for a separate character to be placed later. Rich historical everyday detail and attractive graphic composition. Wall only, NO shopkeeper, NO food bowl in front, NO counter, NO shop sign, NO storefront, NO street, NO perspective floor. Fill canvas edge to edge, no white border.
